title: The Zwischenzug
concept: A zwischenzug is an in-between move. Instead of making the move your opponent expects — like recapturing — you first play a more forcing move that they must answer.
tip: Before you recapture, ask: do I have a check or a bigger threat I can play first?

feedback.correct: Clever! You slipped in a forcing move first — a zwischenzug — and gained before finishing the trade.
feedback.hint: You do not have to recapture right away. Is there a check or threat that comes first?
feedback.reveal: Play the forcing in-between move, make your opponent respond, then come back and complete the exchange with extra profit.
